query:
SELECT e.id, e.nomeDoEquipamento, e.codigoTag, COUNT(pd.id) as totalPD
FROM equipamentos e
INNER JOIN parte_diaria pd ON pd.equipamentoId = e.id AND pd.data >= '2026-04-01' AND pd.data <= '2026-04-30'
WHERE e.id IN (19, 92, 43, 42, 39, 41, 6, 51, 58, 8, 9, 80, 82, 90, 50, 30, 29, 3, 22, 45, 79, 38, 37, 40, 10, 78, 91, 48, 52, 97, 87, 86, 94, 88, 93, 90001, 120060, 120059, 120006, 120017, 120018, 120025, 120036, 120042, 84, 120064, 120067, 120002, 120003, 120004, 120007, 120058)
GROUP BY e.id, e.nomeDoEquipamento, e.codigoTag
ORDER BY totalPD DESC;
